region: US national reference ranges; no automatic local calibration

rates.title: Electrician service call / first hour
rates.assumptions: One routine first-hour service call. Parts, additional labor and corrective repairs excluded. A contractor may credit this charge toward repairs.

rates.title: Replace an existing outlet with GFCI protection
rates.assumptions: Replacement of an existing standard 120V or older GFCI outlet. New circuits, concealed rewiring, outdoor installations and permits excluded. Published per-outlet job range; no extra standard labor added.

rates.title: Routine gutter cleaning
rates.assumptions: Typical residential gutter cleaning project. Height, length, screens and access affect price. This does not correct site grading or install downspout extensions.

rates.title: Roof cleaning
rates.source: HomeGuide · Roof and gutter cleaning costs
rates.assumptions: Typical roof cleaning project; confirm suitability for the roof material, pitch and size. Repairs, roof replacement and gutter cleaning excluded. No automatic bundling discount assumed.

rates.title: Above-ground downspout extension · materials only
rates.assumptions: Basic above-ground extension product only. Installation labor, layout and drainage remediation are not included.

rates.title: Buried downspout drainage extension
rates.assumptions: Published typical system with up to 10 feet of extension, trenching, catch basin, drainpipe and bubbler. Longer runs, difficult excavation and site-specific design require a quote. Selecting this does not establish that burial is the right repair.

rates.title: Standard outdoor handrail installation project
rates.assumptions: Published typical project range, not an unlimited-length railing allowance. Confirm length, material and anchoring; repairs to existing loose rails may differ. Custom work and permits excluded.

rates.title: Basic crawlspace encapsulation · after scope confirmation
rates.assumptions: Published basic encapsulation range per square foot. Not merely the vapor-barrier material price. Structural repairs, mold/pest treatment, water removal, substantial cleaning and additional systems excluded. A specialist must first confirm whether encapsulation is appropriate.
